title: More Bus Services for Fernvale with Increased Number of HDB Flats and Pending Completion of LRT System Upgrade
what_it_is: More Bus Services for Fernvale with Increased Number of HDB Flats and Pending Completion of LRT System Upgrade

sections.label: Fernvale bus services
sections.summary: Fernvale residents are served by bus services to Sengkang town centre and other areas, plus City Direct Service 671 to the city during peak periods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Besides the Light Rail Transit, residents at Fernvale are currently served by bus services that connect them to the transport hub at Sengkang town centre and to other areas, like Ang Mo Kio, Serangoon, Upper Thomson and Yishun.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Additionally, City Direct Service 671 provides a direct connection from Fernvale to and from the city during the morning and evening peak periods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For example, we adjusted the route of Service 102 and increased its capacity to serve the recently completed Fernvale Glades and Fernvale Woods Build-To-Order projects.
